目の前にやってきた杖をついた少女を見た葵は、\n動揺した表情を浮かべながらも彼女: Looking at the girl with the cane who had approached her, Aoi replies to her, an upset expression surfacing on her face.
あ、ああ……久しぶりだな……\nその、足の方は……: A-Ah... It's been a long time... So, how is your leg...?
歩けるようにはなりましたが……後遺症が残ってしまいました。: I've become able to walk again, but... I've been left with lasting aftereffects.
こんなところで出会えるだなんて、思いもしませんでした。: I never imagined I would run into you in a place like this.
どこか余所余所しい会話を続ける葵に疑問を抱く。: Watching Aoi continue this somewhat distant conversation, I start to harbor doubts.
（……ただの顔見知り……にしても、ぎこちないな。\nどういう関係なんだ……？）: (...Even for just acquaintances, this is pretty awkward. What kind of relationship do they have...?)
俺の疑問に感じている視線に気づいたのか、\n葵は俺たちに話をしていた彼女を紹介す: Noticing my inquisitive gaze, Aoi introduces the girl she was speaking with to us.
彼女は昔の……アマツの学園に通っていた頃の同級生だ。\n……在学中に、トラブルが: She's a classmate from back when... I used to attend the academy in Amatsu. ...During our time there, trouble broke out and she took a leave of absence...
しかし……なぜ、このパーティーに君が？: However... why are you at this party?
私が今通っている学校の招待枠として、\nこちらにお邪魔させていただきました。: I am attending here under an invitation slot from the school I currently attend.
ちょうどお世話になっている先生が著名な方でして……\n希望者が参加できるように取: It so happens that the teacher taking care of me is a prominent figure... He arranged it so that anyone interested could participate.
……そう、か。\n君もいい先生に巡り会えたようで良かったよ。: ...Is that so? I'm glad to hear you've met a good teacher as well.
そこで会話は止まってしまう。\n……お互いに何か遠慮をしているようだ。: The conversation halts right there. ...It seems both of them are holding back out of hesitation.
（元同級生だと葵は言っていたが、\nいったいどんな仲だったんだ……？）: (Aoi said they were former classmates, but what on earth was their relationship like...?)
（……普段だったら、もっと親しげに会話をしてるだろうに、\nやけに距離を測るよう: (...Normally, Aoi would be talking much more naturally, but right now it feels like she's cautiously probing the distance between them.)
その気まずい空気に口を出すことはできずに、\n舞亜へと俺は声をかける。: Unable to interject into this awkward atmosphere, I call out to Maia instead.
……なあ、舞亜はあの子を知ってるのか？: ...Hey, Maia, do you know that girl?
……ううん、私も知らないわ。\nでも……もしかしたら……: ...No, I don't know her either. But... just maybe...
昔……私、少しだけ葵から聞いたの。後悔している事があるって。\n……その時は深く: A long time ago... I heard a little bit from Aoi. About how she had something she regretted. ...I didn't pry into it back then, though...
きっと、あの子のことを言っていたのね……: She must have been talking about that girl...
（舞亜にも詳しいことを話してないとなると、\nよほどのことがあったんだろうか……: (If she didn't even share the details with Maia, something really severe must have happened...)
葵とあの少女に横から口を出すことも出来ず、\n気まずく、会話も弾まないふたりを見: Unable to step in between Aoi and the girl, we simply watch over the two as they awkwardly struggle to keep a conversation going, until...
あの時のことは今でも私は夢にみるほど後悔をしている。\n私が、止めていれば……あ: I regret what happened back then so much that I still see it in my dreams to this day. If I... had stopped it, that kind of accident wouldn't have happened.
私のせいで君は……後の人生に響くような怪我をしてしまった。: Because of me, you suffered... an injury that impacts the rest of your life.
君の怪我の責任は私にある。\n……本当に、申し訳ない。: The responsibility for your injury lies with me. ...I am truly, deeply sorry.
ずっと、ずっと心に残っていた。\n君が事故にあって……面会もできなかった。: It has stayed on my mind forever. You met with that accident... and I couldn't even visit you.
私自身……己の過ちに向き合えなくて、\n君と話をすることを諦めてしまっていた。: I myself... couldn't face my own mistakes, and gave up on talking to you.
今更謝っても何の意味もないことは分かっている。\n……だが、それでも謝らせて欲し: I know apologizing now won't change anything. ...Even so, please let me apologize.
葵が顔を上げる。\n……同級生の少女の顔は硬くこわばっていた。: Aoi raises her head. ...Her former classmate's face is stiffly tense.
……謝罪はいりません。謝っていただいて、\nこの足が歩けるようになるわけではあり: ...I don't need an apology. An apology isn't going to make this leg walk properly again...
……すまない。私の出来る限りの責任を――: ...I'm sorry. I will take whatever responsibility I can—
だから、言いましたよね？\n謝罪の必要はありません。: Didn't I just tell you? There is no need to apologize.
……本当に、変わりませんね。生駒さん。\nあなたは……何も分かってない。: ...You really haven't changed, Ikoma-san. You... don't understand anything.
あの時……生駒さんに会いたくなくて面会を断った時から、\nずっと、同じままです。: Since that time... since I turned down your visits because I didn't want to see you, you've remained exactly the same.
それは……どういうことだろうか？: What... do you mean by that?
険悪な空気を感じて、舞亜が仲裁をしようと一歩を踏み出す。: Sensing the tense atmosphere, Maia steps forward to mediate.
私から言えるのは……生駒さんは、\n誰のことも信用していない、ということです。: All I can say is... you don't trust anyone, Ikoma-san.
……今の生駒さんと、お話をするつもりはありません。: ...I have no intention of speaking with the current you, Ikoma-san.
生駒さん……貴方がやるべきことは、違います。\n謝罪なんかじゃないんですよ。: Ikoma-san... what you ought to be doing is something else. It isn't apologizing.
先程からの少女の言葉を聞いて……\n舞亜は、どこか痛みを我慢するように顔を歪めて: Listening to the girl's words... Maia's face contorts slightly, as if enduring pain.
既に少女は去っていた。\n……そして、後には俺達だけが残される。: The girl has already walked away. ...Leaving only us behind.
（……空気が重い……葵もそうだが……舞亜も、\n何か思うことがあるのか考えちゃっ: (...The atmosphere is so heavy... Same for Aoi, but Maia seems to be lost in thought, like she has something on her mind too...)
……ああ、大丈夫だ。気にしないでくれ。: ...Yeah, I'm fine. Don't worry about it.
……え、ええ。私は横で聞いてただけだから……大丈夫よ。: ...Y-Yeah. I was just listening from the side, so... I'm alright.
（……ふたりとも、大丈夫な奴の顔じゃないんだよな）: (...Neither of them looks alright at all.)
このまま、ここで考えても仕方ない。\n少し気分転換をするために場所を変えよう。: Standing around thinking about it here won't help. Let's move somewhere else to change the mood.
……そう、だな。\nこんな調子では、声をかけられてもマトモに応対できそうにないな: ...That's true. In this state, even if someone speaks to me, I don't think I could respond properly...
そうね……会場の端にでも避難しましょうか。: Yeah... Let's take shelter at the edge of the venue.
